**System individuation, 8 October 2026.** [The new module](SystemIndividuation.lean) proves support intersection under actual recombination, a correlated domain with no least support, and formation-dependent preservation of finite event-word feasibility. **27 new theorems / 41 empty audits**, plus 18 unchanged Core audits, pass in the [fresh receipt](system-individuation-checks/20261007T233431.104249Z/receipt.json). [Exact scope](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION-FORMAL.md) distinguishes predictive sufficiency from actual constitution; decidable minimality and unrestricted no-least claims remain separate.

## Systems, constitutive relations and the remaining warrant

The [systems account](SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION.md) develops Ren's next question: what makes something a system, and how do its relationships generate possibilities and changes? Organization is investigated within one unfolding; boundaries preserve the relations relevant to an identified question. Systemhood does not require autonomy, perpetual renewal or one privileged partition.

The [new checked study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION-INTEGRATION.md) adds 27 theorems / 41 empty declaration audits. Joint constraints can permit distinct sufficient descriptions with no least support; an explicit formation establishes a domain where either coordinate preserves all finite event-word feasibility. This is descriptive sufficiency, not evidence that a correlated reading is operatively used.

The systems formulation gives a substantive explanatory candidate but does not supply the full foundational warrant. Actual participation, admissible joint variation, recognition and inference still need warranted scope. No new foundational axiom is adopted, and no formal possibility result is promoted to universal empirical truth. Existing conditional completion and the separate explicit-axiom ethical route are preserved.

## System individuation and constitutive possibilities

8 October 2026. [The systems-foundation continuation](SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION.md) asks which relationships warrant identifying an organization and its boundaries. It credits the exact-reduction and assembly results above, then distinguishes a sufficient description from actual constitutive participation. A coordinated record can arise through a common driver; a correlated substitute can predict an outcome without being used to produce it.

[New Lean results](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION-INTEGRATION.md#2-new-mathematics-and-its-exact-inputs) establish support intersection under admitted recombination and a constrained domain with two sufficient regions but no least one. Formation establishes the domain in which either coordinate preserves every finite event-word possibility; a later distinct event changes pulse availability. All 27 new theorems / 41 declaration audits pass with empty dependencies; 18 inherited core audits are unchanged. These are additional to the older 162-result package, not a recount of it. Actual system boundaries, causal attribution and universal foundational warrant remain substantive obligations.

## 系统边界与构成可能性 / Systems individuation

2026-10-08。仅 C01 成对接入[系统说明与实查](SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION-INTEGRATION.md)，保留已有根据推导及其历史定理计数；新增27项定理／41项空审计，18项继承审计原样复查。预测充分性、实际构成与无假设普遍根据分别说明。/ Only C01 and the owned navigation fragments are updated; unrelated entries and generated lines are preserved. New owned pages alone enter discovery. [Scoped checks](SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION-CHECKS.json) bind the final documents, proof receipts, links and rendered row; concurrent full-table review remains separate. No unrelated scientific rerun, catalogue regeneration or automation is performed.

C01.title_zh: 同一生成展开与关系分化
C01.title_en: One generative unfolding and relational differentiation
C01.claim_zh: 活动形成并转化后续活动的条件；组织、认识、行动与评价在同一展开中分化，并通过实际相连的机制及其对应得到说明。
C01.claim_en: Activity forms and transforms conditions of further activity; organization, knowing, action and evaluation differentiate within one unfolding and are explained through connected mechanisms and their correspondence.
C01.scope_zh: 相连说明在条件范围内已完成；无假设目标继续。既有11项有限重演定理之外，持续阶段25项新定理、27项声明审计；构成可证源对应并传递至复合项，实际适用、逻辑／识别根据与普遍范围仍待证成。 直接构成论证保留已辨认关系的必要内容，排除同一架构普遍实现的额外门槛；全目标域的归属与覆盖尚未证成。本轮无新定理。
C01.scope_en: Connected articulation complete at conditional scope; assumption-free grounding continues. Beyond 11 earlier finite-replay theorems, the sustained investigation has 25 new theorems and 27 audits. Construction can prove source links and propagate correspondence; actual applicability, logical/recognitional warrant and universal scope remain open. The direct constitutive argument preserves established relational content and rejects universal use of one architecture as an extra gate; full-scope attribution and coverage remain unestablished. No new theorem in this assessment.
